raw_segments.text: This is a mortal insult! The little Pole turned as red as a crab, and he went out of the room, briskly, as though unwilling to hear another word.
Vrublevsky swung out after him, and Mitya followed, confused and crestfallen. He was afraid of Grushenka, afraid that the Pan would at once raise an outcry.
And so indeed he did. The Pole walked into the room and threw himself in a theatrical attitude before Grushenka.
